digest.component_or_area: LLM gate infrastructure and cost economics
propositions: Mean cost per completed ticket is 11.85 dollars (median ~8.15, p90 ~21) since the Bedrock switch; plan-review 3.02/run, code-review 1.42/run, completion-verifier 2.24/run.
Nova Pro agentic frontier-slot experiments showed 5/5 verdict agreement and ~30-40x cost reduction (0.07-0.09 per run vs 2.31-3.00 recorded) but blocking-criteria recall only 50-57%.

Code-review ordinal severity axes are inert (0.13% of blocking findings from LLM) due to routing (blocking_enabled=False on 98.2%) and an unreachable 0.95 threshold, not under-reporting or poor findings.

Cheap-model experiments rejected Haiku for agentic review due to 50% false-block rate on hard ACs; Sonnet retained for completion-verification; Nova ceilings and terminal-failure fixes identified as next levers.
Overlap-drain was non-functional (0 findings in 2,093 plan-reviews) and should be disabled or redesigned; caused ~165/5-days local cost with failure storms.
Migration plan (Phase 0-3) is analyzed and written but execution remains blocked on operator approval; all acceptance criteria met via durable ticket records and published artifact.
